pages.text: Each dimension has unique mechanical modifiers beyond mob scaling. Applied by KubeJS server script.$(br2)$(bold)Overworld:$() Baseline. $(bold)Twilight:$() Persistent darkness underground, boss-guarded zones. $(bold)Aether:$() 2x fall damage, no regen while airborne.$(br2)$(bold)Undergarden:$() Constant Poison I, mobs inflict Wither, healing -25%. $(bold)Deeper & Darker:$() Noise detection - armor sound affects aggro radius. $(bold)Nether:$() All mobs aggro'd, lava damage +50%.$(br2)$(bold)Deep Aether:$() Celestial Events every 20 min (+50% mob damage/speed). $(bold)The End:$() 3 zones of escalating difficulty. $(bold)Blue Skies:$() Elemental damage ignores armor.
